checks.name: binomial_response_coefficients
checks.evidence: Closed coefficient formula and recurrence; square is 1-z through degree 24.

checks.name: finite_response_positive_errors
checks.evidence: 36 exact rational cases with a rational square-root value; checks the residual and its stated bound, not convergence as an analytic theorem.

checks.name: joint_one_pass_feedback
checks.evidence: Full matrix feedback Gram equals T-I+(1/4)T^{-1}, with T strictly positive.

checks.name: ordered_mixed_response_words
checks.evidence: Noncommuting two-channel example verifies all words through order six and the exact ordered remainder.

checks.name: orthogonal_low_output_retained
checks.evidence: Range projection, coupling, exact reconstruction and unused output Gram are checked before the new readout.

checks.name: finite_rank_completion
checks.evidence: Exact four-by-four polarized Gram identity, positive rank-two error, and all mixed entries preserved.

checks.name: source_difference_formula
checks.evidence: Checks both terms in formula (28), including the finite low/high correction.

checks.name: elementary_constant_bounds
checks.evidence: Rational log, Euler-constant comparison, pi integral, exponential, sinh-tail and prime-two bounds justify beta_1.

evidence.scope: Coercivity on the cosine complement only; full Q_1 sign is not checked.

limitation: Finite algebra, rational inequalities and a deliberately non-arithmetic control. Not analytical proof certification, a physical normalization law, full Weil positivity, or an RH result.
